data.description: A light weighted pressure plate is a type of pressure plate that produces a redstone signal while one or more entities stand on it. Depending on how many entities are detected, the outputted signal strength will range from 1 to 15.

<p>A <b>light weighted pressure plate</b> is a type of <a href="/w/Pressure_plate" class="mw-redirect" title="Pressure plate">pressure plate</a> that produces a <a href="/w/Redstone" class="mw-disambig" title="Redstone">redstone</a> signal while one or more <a href="/w/Entities" class="mw-redirect" title="Entities">entities</a> stand on it. Depending on how many entities are detected, the outputted <a href="/w/Signal_strength" class="mw-redirect" title="Signal strength">signal strength</a> will range from 1 to 15.
</p>

<p>A light weighted pressure plate can be mined with anything, but <a href="/w/Pickaxe" title="Pickaxe">pickaxes</a> are the fastest. A light weighted pressure plate also breaks and drops itself if a <a href="/w/Piston" title="Piston">piston</a> extends or pushes a block into its location, or if the block under the pressure plate is moved or destroyed.

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Activation">Activation</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Light_Weighted_Pressure_Plate?section=6&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Activation" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Light_Weighted_Pressure_Plate?action=edit&section=6" title="Edit section's source code: Activation"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<div role="note" class="hatnote searchaux">Main article: <a href="/w/Pressure_Plate#Activation" title="Pressure Plate">Pressure Plate § Activation</a></div>
<p>Light weighted pressure plates can be activated by most entities (including players, mobs, items, arrows, experience orbs, fishing bobs, etc.) and emit a redstone <a href="/w/Signal_strength" class="mw-redirect" title="Signal strength">signal strength</a> that is equal to the amount of entities on top of them, up to a maximum power level of 15. Certain entities, however (such as <a href="/w/Players" class="mw-redirect" title="Players">players</a> in <a href="/w/Spectator_mode" class="mw-redirect" title="Spectator mode">spectator mode</a> and <a href="/w/Marker" title="Marker">markers</a>), cannot activate them nor keep them activated.
</p><p>In <a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition"><i>Java Edition</i></a>, <a href="/w/Item_frame" class="mw-redirect" title="Item frame">item frames</a> and <a href="/w/Glow_item_frame" class="mw-redirect" title="Glow item frame">glow item frames</a> cannot activate light weighted pressure plates but they can still keep them activated.<sup id="cite_ref-2" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-2"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>The signal strength from a light weighted pressure plate does not vary with the type of entity. 15 mobs will produce the same signal strength as 15 different items. Note the light weighted pressure plate counts entities, not the quantity of items, generally leading to one entity count per stack of items. For more information see <a href="/w/Item_(entity)#Behavior" title="Item (entity)"> item entity behavior</a>.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Distracting_piglins">Distracting piglins</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Light_Weighted_Pressure_Plate?section=7&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Distracting piglins" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Light_Weighted_Pressure_Plate?action=edit&section=7" title="Edit section's source code: Distracting piglins"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p><a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">Piglins</a> are attracted towards light weighted pressure plates, run toward any light weighted pressure plates on the ground, and inspect them for 6 to 8 seconds before putting them in their <a href="/w/Inventory" title="Inventory">inventory</a> slot. During this time, the piglin does not attack nearby players, even if they are not wearing gold armor.
</p>

</td></tr><tr>
<td>Light weighted pressure plates have been repurposed: rather than outputting based on the amount of and the stack size of <a href="/w/Item_entities" class="mw-redirect" title="Item entities">item entities</a>, their output now depends on the amount of <a href="/w/Entities" class="mw-redirect" title="Entities">entities</a> (including non-item entities) on top of them. As a result, the stack size of item entities is now ignored: for example, dropping a <a href="/w/Stick" title="Stick">stick</a> item and a <a href="/w/Dirt" title="Dirt">dirt</a> item on top of a light weighted pressure plate now results in a higher output signal compared to dropping a full stack of <a href="/w/Sand" title="Sand">sand</a> on it (previously, the opposite would've been the case).
